page.layout: One printed label in a double rule box, centred on the page: two lines in italic capitals. Handwriting around it (pencil and ink) is not printed text and is left out.
page.notes: The scan shows a bookplate label (ex-libris of the Chapter library of Solothurn/Solodorensis) on the cover or flyleaf, surrounded by manuscript pencil and ink shelf marks and notes (e.g. "825", "1659", "Desiderata", "60", "Melanchthon ... Loci theologici"). Handwriting is not transcribed as printed text. Edge of the dark background and the book board are not part of the page.
